infobox.usage: Unlocks the last door on the left in the hallway of Reserve's southern Radar Station.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The RB-RS key (RB-RS) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Federal State Reserve Agency base Radar Station server room.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In the Common fund stash (Shturman's crate)
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: On the middle floor of the Radar Station (Queen) of Reserve; through the last door in the hallway. (Highlighted in green)

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Between 0 and 5 Toolboxes.
- Loose tech loot
